pt-BR: O núcleo do Monky Light agora indica quem está falando na chamada, inclusive você, e ganhou o modo push-to-talk: a escolha fica salva no perfil, e o microfone só transmite enquanto a tecla está pressionada.
en: The Monky Light core now shows who is speaking in the call, including you, and gained a push-to-talk mode: the choice is saved in the profile, and the microphone only transmits while the key is held.
